content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?MEAWW Entertainment's PostMEAWW EntertainmentApril 8 at 2:20 AM · Shared with PublicAubrey Plaza is reportedly pregnant with her first child with partner and actor Christopher Abbott, a year after the death of her husband Jeff Baena in January 2025. A source close to the actress has been quoted in a People Magazine report as saying that the Plaza is due this fall. The source further said, "It was a beautiful surprise after an emotional year [and] they feel very blessed." The actress' representative has also confirmed this news. Plaza and Abbott have professionally collaborated on the off-Broadway revival of 'Danny and the Deep Blue Sea' and the film 'Black Bear'.All reactions:1171 shareLikeComment All reactions:1171 shareLikeComment
